text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky and I go shopping together
one
day...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... These green onions look
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Could I have some of these
along with
the cabbage?

text_block_list.name: Vegetable Seller
text_block_list.text:
You certainly have a good eye for
produce! Take
a raffle ticket too, as a
gift!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A gift? You're giving them out to
everyone, aren't
you?

text_block_list.name: Vegetable Seller
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! You caught me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yep, I'm all set!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But let's enjoy our day a bit longer! You
see, that
old lady told me something
interesting...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! Shall we try it together?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's right! I got a ticket from the lady at the grocery store! We can't not use it, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And if I win, I thought I could reward
you for
coming out with me today by
giving you the prize!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And if I win, I thought I could reward
you for
coming out with me today by
giving you the prize!
choice_data_list: I wonder if we'll win a grand prize?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You dare doubt me? Haha! Well, I can't
wait to
see your reaction when I win the
grand-prize! ♪
choice_data_list: I wonder if we'll win a grand prize?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, allow me to show
you the
fabled Maruzen luck!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, grand-prize! Let's see that
grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky hums as she cranks the
handle of the
raffle spinner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What?! I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you hear that?! I won the
grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you hear that?! I won the
grand-prize!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I know, right?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, here you go! This bodacious prize is
all yours,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, here you go! This bodacious prize is
all yours,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Are you really okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Of course!
choice_data_list: Are you really okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel guilty receiving something like
this just for
going shopping with Maruzensky.
And besides,
she's the one who won it.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come on. You don't have to be so
serious all
the time!
choice_data_list: I can't take this after all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Okay! How about we make it a
date
instead, then?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just like today's shopping trip!
You'll come
with me on the hot spring
trip!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just like today's shopping trip!
You'll come
with me on the hot spring
trip!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: But I'm mega busy this year...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So how about next spring? I'm sure we'll
have
some free time then.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Done deal! I'll invite you when I get
everything
sorted out!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make this trip a lot of fun,
so be
ready to have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I end up promising to go
on a hot
spring trip with Maruzensky
next year.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Booyah! As if there were any doubt! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Sorry, I got a bit carried away,
didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Just remember you said that when I go even more over the top! ♪
choice_data_list: It's the first prize, so isn't it ...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Just remember you said that when I go even more over the top! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahem...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we eat this hamburger steak
together
for lunch?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we eat this hamburger steak
together
for lunch?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! I'm glad to see you can cut
loose a little
yourself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heehee! I'm glad to see you can cut
loose a little
yourself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how Maruzensky and I end up
sharing a
deluxe carrot hamburger steak
for our next lunch.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wow! That sure is a lot!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But having this many carrots is kind of
too much,
even between the both of us...
Carrots go bad
fast, after all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But having this many carrots is kind of
too much,
even between the both of us...
Carrots go bad
fast, after all.
choice_data_list: Shall we share some with everyone?
Shall we share some with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ooh, nice idea, flour tortilla! ♪
choice_data_list: Shall we share some with everyone?
Shall we share some with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who's hungry?! Come get some
carrots!

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! Everyone's looking stoked after
gobbling
up those carrots!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why thank you! ♪ But don't forget
yours, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why thank you! ♪ But don't forget
yours, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky and I each take a single
carrot for
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They're slightly salty and have a
hardiness that
soaks pleasantly into our
tired bodies.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aww, dang!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess a little bit of good luck is
better
than none at all.
choice_data_list: Let's just call it decent luck.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But a single carrot doesn't really make
for a great
present... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! I'll use this and the green
onions I
bought earlier to make a stir-fry!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It's my mom's secret recipe, so it'll be
the bomb!
You're gonna love it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later on, we enjoy a delicious stir-fry
made with
the carrot that Maruzensky
won in the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, that's a blank—tough luck! Here's
this pack
of tissues as a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Bogus! I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Sorry, Trainer. My Maruzen luck
let me
down today...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Sorry, Trainer. My Maruzen luck
let me
down today...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Aww, I wanted to win you something
nice... Mega
lame...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Maruzensky's shoulders drooping,
we leave
the shopping street.
